steps.instruction: Check the current contents of src/lib/game-engine.ts and the existing app directory structure to ensure alignment for the UI implementation.

Create the main game interface in src/app/page.tsx using a high-performance React render loop and HTML5 Canvas. Implement the player ship, alien grid, and projectile rendering. Add a start screen with a button (data-anvil-action='primary') and a game-over overlay with a restart button (data-anvil-action='restart'). Ensure the root element or a state container updates data-anvil-state with the current score and level. Import and integrate the logic from src/lib/game-engine.ts.
Create a smoke-check.js script that reads src/app/page.tsx and verifies the presence of the required data-anvil attributes using regular expressions to avoid shell quoting issues.
Run the smoke-check.js script to verify data-anvil-action='primary', data-anvil-action='restart', and data-anvil-state implementation.
Run the production build to ensure the game UI and logic compile correctly without TypeScript errors.
